COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
BA1 No. 1240 of 2023
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
 Mr. Yogesh Sharma and Mr.
Pankaj Semwal, learned counsels for
the applicant.
 Mr. P. S. Uniyal, Brief Holder for
the State.
 The applicant Amit Negi, who is in
Jail in connection with FIR No 274 of
2022, under Sections 419, 420, 467,
468, 471 and 120B IPC, Police Station
Kotdwar, District Pauri Garhwal, has
sought his release on bail.
 Heard learned counsel for the
parties and considered the grounds
taken up in the bail application.
 Learned counsel for the applicant
submitted that the applicant has been
assigned only a role of drawing a
settlement between the parties and
offered one Bigha of land to him in
Kishanpuri Kotdwar instead of the land
mentioned in the sale-deed. Apart from
it, there is no role assigned to the
applicant.
 Leaned counsel for the State has
drawn our attention to the rejection
order, in which, it has come that the
applicant Amit Negi was found using an
Adhar Card of Rohit Singh.
 In reply, it is submitted by learned
counsel for the applicant that the
Aadhar Card which has been shown in
possession of the applicant is planted
upon him.
 In view of the averments made in

the FIR and the role which has been
assigned to the applicant, the bail
application is allowed.
 Let the applicant be released on
bail, on his executing a personal bond
and furnishing two reliable sureties,
each of the like amount, to the
satisfaction of Court concerned.

( Pan k aj Pu r oh it , J.)
 26.05.2023
Kaushal
